capabilities: Publish a note as a Google Doc and record its URL in frontmatter
Push local edits and pull remote edits on a poll interval or on demand
Auto-merge non-overlapping changes from both sides
Surface overlapping conflicts with inline diff markers without overwriting either side
Connect a Google account via one-click OAuth with no API keys
disambiguation: Not a whole-vault Google Drive sync; it links individual notes to individual Google Docs, one note at a time.
extras: Not yet in the Community Plugins directory, so it must be installed manually from releases; the manifest notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. Desktop only (needs Node APIs for the OAuth loopback). Markdown round-trips through Google's exporter, so Obsidian-only syntax like wikilinks, callouts, embeds and Dataview may degrade; images, comments and suggestions are not synced.
intentEvidence: This plugin focuses on per-note publishing + reliable two-way sync with explicit conflict surfacing
motivation: The author wanted a middle ground between copy-pasting back and forth and migrating the note out of the vault entirely.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to collaborate on one document with people who work in Google Docs, forcing copy-paste round-trips or moving the note out of the vault.

relations.evidence: Publish a single Obsidian note to Google Docs and keep the two in two-way sync
